<a> and <kicihna> written as one word, placed after a name: that which is called by this name, as {Lake Abaya akicihna}, the place called Lake Abaya
<a> and <kiciliang> written as one word, placed after a name or description: that is even called so, that goes by that name
<a> and <kicim> written as one word: it collapsed, or the one that collapsed, said of buildings, roads and bridges
<a> and <kicimsuk> written as one word: it collapsed, or the one that collapsed, said of buildings, ceilings and ground
<a> and <kicin> written as one word: it is complete, fulfilled or sufficient; {akicin lohna} is where something is lacking
<a> and <kicing> written as one word: what is complete or enough; {akicing in} or {akicing takin} is in full, sufficiently
<a> and <kicingin> written as one word: in full, with nothing lacking; {athu akicingin} is the whole of the matter, in full detail
<a> and <kicinglo> written as one word: that which is not enough or not complete
<a> and <kicingtak> written as one word, mostly followed by <in>: in full, enough, as of time that is given
<a> and <kicingzaw> written as one word: the fuller one; {akicingzaw in} is more fully, in full
<akici>, that is called, and <nu>, woman, written as one word after a name: the woman so called
<a> and <kicip> written as one word: it collapses, said of a building, a wall or the ground
<a> and <kicipa> written as one word: the man who is called by the name that stands before it
<akici>, that is called, and the topic marker <pen> written as one word, placed after a name: the one called by that name, as the topic of the sentence
<a> and <kicipna> written as one word: the collapsing of a building, a tower or the ground, or the place where it gave way
<akicip>, it collapses, with <suk>, down, written as one word: it collapses downward, said of a building, a tower or a ceiling
<a> and <kicite> written as one word and placed after a name: those who are called by that name, the so-called
<a> and <kidal> written as one word: it is shielded or protected, or shields itself, from something
<a> and <kidalna> written as one word: what screens or blocks off, in the news mostly the divider or guardrail of a road
<a> and <kidawh> written as one word: that is stretched or laid out, said of a bridge, flyover or pier built across something and of a cloth held out
<a> and <kidawk> written as one word: that shows, that is exposed or sticks out
<a> and <kidawm> written as one word: he is careful, the one who takes care, or the thing one guards against
<a>, <ki> and <dawt> written as one word: he or she was stabbed
<a>, <ki> and <dawtliam> written as one word: he or she was wounded by stabbing
<a>, <ki>, <dawt>, stab, and <lum>, to death, written as one word: was stabbed to death, the one stabbed to death; with {amah leh amah}, stabbed himself or herself to death
<akidawt>, was stabbed, with the ending {-na} written as one word: the place where a person was stabbed, the wound, or the stabbing itself
<a> and <kideih> written as one word: it is wanted or required; of a person, wanted by the police, or much liked
<a> and <kidelh> written as one word: they hurry to a place, or they chase one another
<a>, <kidelh> and <leh> written as one word: when they chased one another
<aki> and <delhna>, pursuit, written as one word: the chasing of someone, a chase; {akidelhna panin} is in the course of the chase
<a> and <kidem> written as one word: competes, the one who competes, said of rivals in business, a contest or an election
<a> and <kidim>, be filled, written as one word: that is full; after a noun with <tawh> it means full of or filled with that thing
<a> and <kido> written as one word: they fight each other, or the ones fighting; {gal akido} is they wage war
<a>, the verb prefix <ki> and <dong>, ask, written as one word: was asked, the one who was asked; of money, was asked for, collected
<a> and <kidop> written as one word: that someone is careful; {akidop nadingin} is so that they take care
<a> and <kidot> written as one word, mostly as {akidot ciangin}: when he was asked
<a> and <kigak> written as one word: of time short, of a place or vehicle packed full, of relations between countries tense
<a> and <kigam> written as one word, the first part of <kigamla>: that is far from something, after <tawh>

terms: be far from/be distant/be at a distance of
definition: <a> and <kigamla> written as one word: that is far from, lying at the distance named; {akigamla lo} is not far away

terms: at a distance of/the distance away/distance
definition: <a> and <kigamlatna>, distance apart, written as one word: after a measure, that lies so far away, as in {tai 3 akigamlatna}, three miles away
<a> and <kigawm> written as one word: what is joined or added together; {akigawm in} is in total, altogether, and before a noun it means that has joined
<a> and <kigawmkhawm> written as one word: that are joined into one, united
<a> and <kigeel>, be planned, written as one word: that is planned, it is planned; {dingin akigeel} is it is planned to
<akigeel>, it is planned, with <sa>, already: it had been planned or scheduled, often of a plan that did not come about
<a> and <kigel>, be planned, written as one word: it is planned, that which is planned
<a> and <kigelh> written as one word: it is written, or that which is written

terms: where it is written/what is written
definition: <a> and <kigelhna> written as one word: the place or text in which something is written, mostly as {akigelhna ah}, in what is written
<a> and <kigen> written as one word: it is said, what is said or spoken of
<a> and <kigenkhia> written as one word: what has been stated or made known
<a> and <kigenna>, the telling, written as one word: what is said or reported about something; <athu akigenna ah> is according to what is reported

terms: according to reports/as reported/it is said that
definition: <akigenna>, what is said, and <ah>, in: in what is told, according to the report; it opens a news sentence, mostly as <athu akigenna ah>, and the sentence often ends in <kici> or <cihi>
<a> and <kigensa> written as one word: what has already been said or laid down; {akigensa ahihi} is it has been stated
<a> and <kigin>, get ready, written as one word: he or they get ready
<a> and <kiging> written as one word: is ready, the one who is prepared
<a> and <kigingsa> written as one word, mostly followed by <in> and a form of <om>: in readiness, on the alert
<a> and <kigu> written as one word: it was stolen, or beside a noun the one that was stolen
<a> and <kigual> written as one word: those who are lined up or standing in a queue
<a> and <kigukhia>, be stolen away, written as one word: it was stolen, the thing that was stolen
<a> and <kihal>, be burned, written as one word: it was burning, or that which was set on fire; of a fire also one that was lit on purpose

terms: be set on fire/be burned on purpose
definition: <a> and <kihalsak> written as one word: it was set on fire by someone, said of a fire that was started deliberately
<a> and <kihawm> written as one word: that is divided or given out
<a> and <kihawmkhia> written as one word: that was released or published, of a film or of news
<a> and <kihel> written as one word: who takes part, that is included or involved, said of people in an event and of things in a whole
<a>, <kihel>, take part, and <ding>, will, written as one word: who or what will take part or be included; {akihelding in aki ummawh} is suspected of being involved
<a>, <kihel> and <kha> written as one word: that happens to be involved or included in something

terms: one who took part/one of those involved
definition: <akihel>, who takes part, and <khat>, one, written as one word: one who was involved in something or one who belongs to a group
<akihelkha> with the plural <te>: the people who are involved in or take part in something
<a> and <kihello> written as one word: the one that is not included, that which has nothing mixed in
<a> and <kihelna> written as one word: his or their taking part, or that in which someone is involved
<akihel> with the plural <te> written as one word: those who take part or are included

terms: can take part/who is able to join
definition: <a> and <kihelthei> written as one word: who can take part or is included, will be able to attend
<a>, <kihel> and <zel> written as one word: one that is regularly included or regularly takes part
<a> and <kihemkhia> written as one word: who moved or were moved away from a place of danger, also of animals taken away

terms: move aside/get out of the way/step aside
definition: <a> and <kihep> written as one word: move to one side, clear out of the way, as a person off a railway track or a crowd off the road
<a> and <kihhuai> written as one word: disgusting, that which is loathsome
<a> and <kihilh> written as one word: it is taught, or that which is taught
<a> and <kihingmat>, be captured alive, written as one word: those who were taken alive in battle, named after the dead and the wounded
Proud or arrogant, from <kihisak>, be proud, with the prefix <a> written joined; {akihisak mite} are the proud.
<a> and <kiho> written as one word: who talk with one another, when they talk together
<a> and <kihon> written as one word: it is opened, that which is opened, said of doors, schools, shops and businesses; {akihon kik} is reopen
<a> and <kihona> written as one word: his or their conversation, the talks they hold
<a> and <kihong>, be opened, written as one word: it is opened, or before a noun the one that is open, said of schools, shops and railway lines
<akihong>, it is opened, with <ding>, will, written as one word: that which is going to be opened, as a shop or a building
<a> and <kihongkhia> written as one word: it was opened, the one that is opened, said of a shop or a service starting

terms: be newly opened/open for the first time
definition: <akihong>, be opened, and <thak>, new, written as one word: was newly opened, said of shops and hotels
<a> and <kihopih> written as one word: who is spoken with, who talks with someone; {akihopih te} are the people one talks with
<a> and <kihtak>, fear, written as one word: the one who is afraid, or what he fears; paired with <alau>
<a> and <kihhuai> written as one word and with one h: that is disgusting, of dirty things and of shameful behaviour
<a> and <kihuai> written as one word: that look after and stand by one another, of a people
<a> and <kihuh> written as one word: who is helped, or who help one another
<a> and <kiim> written as one word: the area around it; <akiim apam> is all around, the whole neighbourhood

<akiim>, around it, and <apaam>, its neighbourhood, said as a pair: the whole area round a place; stands before <ah> or <teng>, or before a noun as {akiim apaam gamte}, the surrounding countries; with other pronouns {i kiim i paam}, all around us
<akiim>, around it, and <apam>, its vicinity: a pair of near synonyms that together name the whole area round about a place, often followed by <teng>, all, or by <ah>, in
<a> and <kik>, again, written as one word: the next one, the time after this; {akik ciangin} and {akik ah} are next time, afterwards
<a> and <kikah.3> written as one word: it is attended, people go to it, said of a school, a course or a meeting
<a> and <kikai> written as one word: that is pulled along, or of a fence, that is put up, as in {dai akikai}
<a> and <kikaih>, be drawn, written as one word, before <khopna> or <khawp>: that are brought together, of people who gather or of things that are collected
<a> and <kikaikhawm> written as one word: that has been collected, or that have gathered in one place
<a> and <kikal> written as one word: what lies between two places, parties or times; {akikal ah} is in between or in the meantime, {akikal panin} is from the middle, as a go-between
<a> and <kikan> written as one word: when it was investigated or inquired into; {akikan ciangin} is on investigation
<a> and <kikanna> written as one word: the looking into a matter; {athu akikanna ah} is on investigation of the matter
<a> and <kikap> written as one word: was shot, there was shooting, they fired at each other
<a>, <kikap> and <kha> written as one word: who was hit by a shot, the one who was shot

terms: be shot/be hit by a shot
definition: <aki> and <kapkhak> written as one word: he or it was hit by gunfire
<a>, <kikap> and <khit> written as one word, before <ciangin> or <zawh>: after they had shot at each other, after the fighting
<a> and <kikapliam> written as one word: was shot and wounded, the one who was shot and wounded, usually after <thautawh>, with a gun

terms: was shot dead/the one shot dead
definition: <a> and <kikaplum> written as one word: was shot dead, or before a noun the one who was shot dead
<a>, <ki> and <kaplup> written as one word: was shot dead, the one who was shot dead
<a> and <kikapna> written as one word: the shooting, either the fighting of two sides with guns or the shooting of one person; {akikapna liamma} is a gunshot wound

terms: how he was shot/manner of the shooting
definition: <akikap>, was shot, with <zia>, way or manner: the way in which someone was shot, the circumstances of a shooting
<a> and <kikem> written as one word: is kept or cared for, the one who is kept, as a patient in hospital or a prisoner in detention; also he keeps himself or guards his mouth
<a> and <kikemcip> written as one word: he or she is detained, or the one who is detained
<a> and <kikep> written as one word: being kept, held or cared for, as a patient in hospital or a person in custody; {akikep laitak} is is now being kept

terms: place where one is kept/place of custody
definition: <a> and <kikepna> written as one word, here the noun of <kikem>, be kept: where someone is kept, held or cared for, placed before the name of the place, as a prison, a zoo, a hospital or a school
<a> and what seems to be <kikhak> written as one word and without the final {k}: of a child, be left with someone who looks after it
<a> and what seems to be <kikhak>, be shut, written as one word and without the final {k}: of businesses, that were closed
<a> and <kikhah> written as one word: it is put out to the public, or the ones held are released
<a> and <kikhahkhia> written as one word: that was released, said of prisoners set free and of photos or video made public
<a> and <kikhai> written as one word: that hangs or is hung up, hanging
<a> and <kikhai> written as one word, here in the sense be apart: differ from one another
<a> and <kikhailum> written as one word: he or she hanged himself or herself, or the one who is put to death by hanging
<a> and <kikhak> written as one word: it is closed, the one that is shut, said of doors, schools, offices and businesses
<a> and <kikhakding> written as one word: that it will be closed, said of an office or a shop
<a> and <kikham> written as one word: it is forbidden, that which is forbidden
<aki> and <khamcip> written as one word: it is strictly forbidden, that which is banned
<a> and <kikhan>, be enlarged, written as one word: it is increased, said of pay and of security measures; {amah tawh akikhan} is one who grew up with him
<a> and <kikhawi> written as one word: that is kept or reared, said of animals on a farm or in a zoo
<a> and <kikhawina> written as one word, after the name of an animal: the place where it is kept or reared
<a> and <kikhawl> written as one word: who keeps company with others; {mite tawh akikhawl thei} is one who can get along with people
<a>, <ki> and <khawl>, here stop or rest, written as one word: that has stopped or stands still; {tui akikhawl} is water left standing and {nasep akikhawl sak} is one whose work has been stopped
<a> and <kikhawlsak> written as one word: that was stopped or suspended, the one who was made to stop work
<a> and <kikhawm> written as one word: those who gather, the people who attend a meeting or worship
<a> and <kikheel> written as one word: it changes, or that which changes; {akikheel ngeilo} is that never changes
<a> and <kikhek> written as one word: it is exchanged, what is exchanged for another thing
<a> and <kikhel> written as one word: it changes, or before a noun the one that changes; {akikhel ngeilo} is never changing
<a> and <kikhem>, be deceived or deceive one another, written as one word
<a> and <kikhen> written as one word: they separate or are divided, the one who is separated; said of husband and wife who part and of a group that splits
<a> and <kikhenna> written as one word: the place where something is divided, in the articles the divider between the two sides of a road
<a> and <kikhia> written as one word: it was dropped or thrown down onto a place, said of a bomb; {thong akikhia} is was sentenced to prison
<a> and <kikhial> written as one word: it is a mistake, or what is mistaken, an error
<a> and <kikhiat> written as one word: that was dropped, said of a bomb, and that is imposed, said of a prison sentence
<a> and <kikhiatna> written as one word: the dropping of a thing from a height, as a bomb from a plane, and {akikhiatna mun}, the place where it was dropped
<a> and <kikhin> written as one word: that which is moved, of an appointment or date put off to another time
<a> and <kikhol> written as one word: that which has been stored up or has piled up
<a> and <kikhop> written as one word: they gather, used before <uhciangin> and similar words
<a> and <kikhumna> written as one word: where someone is shut in, or the time a person is held in custody

terms: be strung/be stretched across/be put up
definition: <a> and <kikhung> written as one word: that is stretched or put up across a space, of a wire, cable, bar or signboard
<a> and <kikilh>, be nailed, written as one word: it is nailed, the thing that is nailed
<a> and <kikim> written as one word: equal, the same in amount; with <in>, equally
<akikim> and <ding> written as one word: that will be equal to an amount, or with <in>, so as to be equal or level
<a> and <kikoih> written as one word: it is put or kept somewhere, or before a noun the thing that is put there
<a> and <kikoihna> written as one word: the place or container in which the thing named before it is kept, followed by the name of the place or container

terms: the one that was put/what is placed
definition: <akikoih>, that is put or kept, and the topic marker <pen> written as one word: the one that was put or left somewhere, as the topic of the sentence
<a> and <kikoihsa> written as one word: that has already been put somewhere, entered on a list or appointed
<a> and <kikum> written as one word: they discuss, what is discussed, the ones who discuss
<a> and <kikup> written as one word: they discuss, or what is discussed
<a> and <kila> written as one word: that which is taken; said of data taken from a source, a tax or fee that is charged, and goods or water brought from a place
<a> and <kilah> written as one word: when it is shown, as a performance; of a sick person, show oneself to a doctor or at a clinic, be examined
<a> and <kilai> written as one word: they fight, those who fight one another
<a> and <kilaih> written as one word: is changed or replaced, the one that has changed; <pan> marks what it was before and <ah> what it becomes
<a> and <kilaihding> written as one word: that is to be changed or replaced
<a> and <kilak> written as one word: that is shown, displayed or revealed, as a film or a culture shown to the public
<a> and <kilak> written as one word: that is taken, as leave from work, a tooth that is pulled, or a camp captured in war

terms: to be examined/to see a doctor
definition: <a>, <kilak>, show oneself to a doctor, and <ding>, to, written as one word: in order to be examined at a hospital or clinic
<a> and <kilakhia> written as one word: that was captured, said of a town or camp in war news, or that was taken out of a place
<a> and <kilam> written as one word: was built, the one that is built
<a> and <kilamdang>, be different, written as one word: that is different, what differs, with <tawh> for what it differs from
<a> and <kilamdanna> written as one word: the difference between two things or groups, how they differ

terms: to be built/that will be built
definition: <akilam> and <ding> written as one word, placed before a noun: the one that is going to be built
<a>, <kilam>, be built, and the ending {-san}, in progress, written as one word: that is being built; {akilamsan laitak} is while it was under construction
<akilam>, that is built, and <thak>, new, written as one word: newly built, said of a bridge, a prison or a stadium
<akilam> and <zawh>, finish, written as one word: since it was built, after its building was finished, followed by a length of time
<a> and <kilang>, appear, written as one word: it appears, that which is shown; {akilang sak} is the one that makes it show
<a> and <kilangh>, appear, written as one word: that shows, what is evident; {akilangh pen} is the most evident thing
<a> and <kilangsak> written as one word: who reveals, or that it be revealed
<a> and <kilat> written as one word: it appears, its appearing, used before words such as <ciangin> and <theihna>
<a> and <kilau> written as one word: that is feared, or they are afraid
<a> and <kilawh> written as one word: of a disease, pass from one person to another, or the ones to whom it has passed; {akilawh thei natna} is a contagious disease
<akilawh>, that spreads from one to another, and <thei>, can: contagious, infectious; it stands before the noun, {akilawh thei natna} is a contagious disease
<a> and <kilawhgawp> written as one word: of a fire or a disease, it spread badly
<a>, <kilawh>, be transmitted, and <kha> written as one word: who have caught an illness, to whom it has spread
<a> and <kilawhna.1> written as one word: the spreading of a disease from person to person
<a> and <kilawhna.2> written as one word: what a place or thing is called
<aki> and <lawhphei> written as one word: of fire or disease, it spreads across to what is next to it
<a> and <kilawhthei> written as one word: that can spread, said of a disease that passes from an animal, an insect, food or a person; {panin akilawhthei} is that spreads from
Fitting, proper or deserved, from <kilawm> with the prefix <a> written as one word; {sihna thuak ding akilawm} is deserving of death, and {akilawm kei hi} is it is not reasonable.
<akilawm>, fitting, with <lo>, not, written as one word; {akilawmlo in gamtatna} is improper or indecent behaviour
<a> and <kilawn> written as one word: that is thrown or flung, said also of firecrackers that are set off

terms: go back and forth/go about/run to and fro
definition: <a> and <kileh> written as one word: that goes to and fro, often with <kawikawi>, of people patrolling, of trains running between two places and of animals running about
<a> and <kilehbulh> written as one word, used with <tawh>: that is contrary or opposite to something
<a> and <kilehkik> written as one word: it turned back, when someone comes back; said often of an aircraft returning
<a> and <kilei> written as one word: it was bought, or that which is bought; with <tawh> for the price
<a> and <kilem> written as one word: they are at peace or get along with one another; in the dictionary data also what fits or is in harmony
<a> and <kilimzat> written as one word: that is much used, widely used or popular
<a> and <kilot> written as one word: it is thrown or shot, what is thrown
<a> and <kiluh>, be raided or plundered, written as one word: it was robbed or broken into, the place that was robbed
<a> and <kilut> written as one word: people go in, a place is entered; before <ciangin>, when one enters
<a> and <kim> written as one word: the area around it; <akim akiang> and <akim apam> are the whole surrounding area
<a> and <kim> written as one word: complete, with none missing; {akim in} is in full or all of them, and {lung akim} is be satisfied

<akim>, its surroundings, and <akiang>, beside it: the whole area around a place; it follows the name of the place and <le> or <leh>, and stands before a noun as surrounding, as in {akim akiang khua teng}, all the villages around
<akim>, the area around it, paired with <apam>, the place beside it: everything that lies around a place, all the surrounding area; it stands before the things or places meant or before {aa om}
<kiman>, be of use, with the prefix <a> and the noun suffix <na>; {bangmah akiman’na om lo} is there is nothing of worth in it
<a> and <kimang> written as one word: that is in use or in force, that lasts for a time, that is of use
<a>, <kiman>, be caught, and <kha>, happen to, written as one word: the ones who got caught or arrested
<a>, the passive prefix <ki> and <mankhia> written as one word: he was arrested, or the one who was arrested
<a> and <kimankhin> written as one word: who have already been arrested, those arrested so far
<a>, <kiman>, be arrested, and <lak>, among, written as one word and followed by <ah>: among the people who were arrested
<a>, <kiman>, be arrested, and <pa>, man, written as one word: the man who was arrested

terms: was arrested at once/was caught immediately
definition: <a> and <kimanpah> written as one word: he or she was arrested right away
<a>, <kiman>, be arrested, and the topic marker <pen>, written as one word: the person who was arrested, as the topic of the sentence
<a> and <kiman>, be arrested, with the ending {-sa}, already done, written as one word before a noun: those who have already been arrested
<a>, <kiman>, be arrested, and <suak>, right through, written as one word: was arrested and taken away, or those who were arrested
<a> and <kimante> written as one word: the people who were caught or arrested

terms: all that was seized/all those arrested
definition: <a>, <kiman> and <teng>, here all, written as one word: everything that was seized, or all the people who were arrested
<a> and <kimanthei>, can be caught, written as one word: the one who could be caught or arrested, mostly as {akimanthei ahihi}, it was thus that he could be caught
<a> and <kimat> written as one word: the one who was arrested, what was seized, or when he was arrested

terms: be arrested in addition/be arrested as well
definition: <a> and <kimatbeh> written as one word: the one who was arrested in addition to those arrested before
<akimat>, be arrested, and <ding>, will, written as one word: that he or she will be arrested; often before a word of fear, as {akimatding lau}, afraid of being arrested
<aki> and <matkhiat> written as one word: he or they are caught, used before words such as <ciangin> and <theih>
<akimat>, was arrested or seized, and <khit>, after, written as one word, mostly before <ciangin>
<akimat> and <leh>, if, written as one word: if he is arrested
<a> and <kimatna> written as one word: the arrest of someone or the seizure of something, or the place of it or reason for it
<a> and <kimawh> written as one word; it stands before <sak> as {akimawh sak}, is blamed, is held at fault by others
<a> and <kimawhsakna> written as one word: the accusation made against someone, the charge that is brought
<a> and <kimawl> written as one word: he or they play, or the one who plays, a player
<a> and <kimawlmawl> written as one word: he or they are playing, or the one who plays on and on with something
<a> and <kimawlna> written as one word: what a child plays with, or his playing and the place of it
<a> and <kimawlpih> written as one word: he plays with, and the one with whom someone plays
<a> and <kimin> written as one word: the whole of it, with nothing left out; of news, in full detail
<a> and <kimtak> written as one word, mostly {akimtak in}: in full, with nothing missing
<a> and <kimu> written as one word, here as the passive of <mu>, see: that is seen or found; {akimu theilo} is unseen, invisible
<a> and <kimuang> written as one word: the one who is trusted or relied on; also being confident, sure of oneself
<a> and <kimuding> written as one word: who will meet, in order to meet
<a> and <kimuh> written as one word: it was found or seen, mostly before <ciangin>, when
<a> and <kimuh> written as one word: they meet or met each other
<a>, <kimuh> and <khiat> written as one word: it was found or discovered; the form used before a noun or a word such as <ciangin>, as {akimuhkhiat hun}, the time it was found
<a>, <kimuh>, be found, and <leh>, if, written as one word: if it is found, if someone is found or caught doing it
<akimuh> and <ma>, before, written as one word: before it was found or seen

terms: place where it was found/being found/being seen
definition: <a> and <kimuhna> written as one word: the place where, or the fact that, something was found or seen; also their meeting each other
<akimuh> and the topic marker <pen> written as one word: as for its being found, as for when it was found
<a> and <kimukhia> written as one word: was found, was discovered, or the one that was found

terms: who do not meet/not see each other
definition: <a>, <kimu>, meet, and <lo>, not, written as one word: who do not meet, with <tawh> for the person
<a> and <kimuthei> written as one word: what can be seen, the visible; the opposite is <akimutheilo>, the unseen
<a>, <kimuthei> and <lo> written as one word: that cannot be seen
<a> and <kin> written as one word: what is urgent, or one who is eager and cares about something; before a verb, urgently or with care
<a> and <kinai> written as one word: that is near or close to something, used with <tawh>; with <pen> the nearest; also of a close relation
<a> and <kinaipen> written as one word: the nearest, with <tawh> for the place it is nearest to
<a> and <kinaipih> written as one word: who is a close relative
<a> and <kinei> written as one word: that is had or held, what people have, as a view, a feeling or a meeting
<a> and <kineih>, pretend, written as one word: one who makes himself out to be what he is not; follows the thing pretended
<a>, the prefix <ki> and <neih>, have or hold, written as one word: that is held or carried out, of a meeting, a check or an attitude

terms: after it has been held/has been held
definition: <aki> and <neihkhit>, have held, written as one word: with <ciangin>, after a hearing, meeting or event has been held
<a>, <ki> and <neihna> written as one word: the holding of something, or the occasion and place at which an inquiry, a hearing or a protest is held, as {thusitna akineihna}, the hearing that was held
<a> and <kineikhin> written as one word: it has already been held or done
<a> and <kinek> written as one word: that is eaten, when it is eaten
<a> and <kinga> written as one word, after <tungah> or {tung ah}: that which depends or rests on someone or something
<a> and <kingah> written as one word: it is obtained, or that which is got or received
<a> and <kingai> written as one word: those who love each other as man and woman, or the one someone is in love with
<a> and <kingaihsun.3> written as one word: it is thought of or regarded in a certain way, often before <ahihi>
<a> and <kinusia>, be left, written as one word: that has been left behind or abandoned, of a child, a thing or a message
<a> and <kip> written as one word: what is firm or established, be firmly established; {akip akho} is stable and lasting
<a> and <kipaai>, be thrown away, written as one word before a noun or <khat>: one that was thrown away; said here of a newborn baby that was abandoned
<a> and <kipahtawi> written as one word: who is honored or exalted, or the day on which someone is honored
<a> and <kipai> written as one word, here in the sense be thrown away: that was thrown away or left behind, said of rubbish and of an abandoned baby
<a> and <kipai> written as one word: when one goes, the going
<aki> and <paina>, going, written as one word: after a length of time, the place that is so long a journey away
marks the starting point in time, place or a list, often after <pan>; {amah akipan a innkuanpihte} means him and all his household
<a>, <kipan> and <ding> written as one word: it will begin, that which is to begin; often with a date and {hita hi}

terms: take a stand/side with/take the lead
definition: <a> and <kipang> written as one word: he or they take up a position, on the side of someone or at the front; in one article it stands for <akipan>, since
{a kipanin} written as one word; follows the time or thing that is the starting point
<a> and <kipankhia> written as one word: that began or started out from a time, a place or a source
<a> and <kipankhin> written as one word: it has already begun or been started
<a> and <kipanpah> written as one word: start right away, placed after the action that is begun
<a> and <kipanta> written as one word: it has now begun
<kipat>, begin, with the prefix <a> written joined; {akipat ni} is the first day
<kipat>, begin, with the prefix <a> written joined, as the verb of a clause before <ciangin>, <laitak> or <hun>: it began, as a fire or a meeting; not the adjective first
<a> and <kipatcil> written as one word: the beginning; {akipatcil in} is at first, at the beginning
<a> with <kipat>, begin, and <khiat>, out, written as one word: that or when something was started; {akipatkhiat kum} is the year it began
<a>, <kipatlam>, the early part, and <pawl>, about, written as one word after the name of a month: around the beginning of that month
<a> and <kipatma> written as one word: before something begins, often with <in> or with a length of time after it
<a> and <kipatna> written as one word: its beginning, the place or cause from which something started
<a>, <kipat>, begin, and the topic marker <pen> written as one word: as for when or where something began
<a>, <kipat> and <zawh> written as one word, with <zawh> in the sense after: since something began, followed by the length of time that has passed

terms: be joined with/be associated with/go with
definition: <kipawl>, associate, with the prefix <a> written as one word, placed after <tawh> and before a noun: that is joined with, that goes with
<a> and <kipawlkhawm>, join together, written as one word: who have joined together, those allied with someone
<a> and <kipawlpih> written as one word before a noun: that is allied with, its ally or partner
<a> and <kipawlpihte> written as one word: those who are joined with them, their allies
<a> and <kipei> written as one word: it spins, the one that turns round, said of machines, blades and wheels
<a> and <kipelh> written as one word: what is avoided or missed; after <tawh>, what does not agree with a rule or a record, and {akipelh thei lo} is unavoidable
<a>, <kiphal> be allowed and the negative <lo> written as one word: that is not permitted; after a verb with <ding>, not allowed to do it
<a> and <kiphawk> written as one word: they realise or become aware of something; also the one that is remembered or noticed

terms: be hung out/be spread out to dry
definition: <a> and <kipho> written as one word: that is hung or spread out, said of washing put out to dry
<a> and <kiphuak> written as one word: of a song, composed; of a name or a word, given or made up
<a>, the passive prefix <ki> and <phuan>, set up, written as one word: that was founded, of an association, a committee or a court
<a> and <kiphuankhia> written as one word: that was founded, of a school, a district or an organisation
<a> and <kiphukha>, collide, written as one word: they collided, the ones that collided, said of vehicles
<a> and <kiphum> written as one word: that is buried, said of a body, a mine or a pipe under the ground
<a> and <kiphut> written as one word: that was set up or founded, as an organisation, or that is fixed or stuck in something
<a> and <kiphut> written as one word, said of people: who are crowding together in a place, as {akiphut ziahziah}
<a>, the prefix <ki> and <phutkhak> written as one word: they collided, the ones that collided, said of vehicles
<a> and <kipia> written as one word: that is given, the one to whom something is given
<a> and <kipiading> written as one word: that will be given, granted or imposed, as aid, a title or a sentence
<a> and <kipiak> written as one word: it is given, that which is given; {akipiak nadingin} is in order that it be given
<a> and <kipiakhia> written as one word: one who gives himself to a cause, a volunteer; also what is given out
<a> and <kipiakhin> written as one word: that has already been given, said of time allowed for doing something
<a> and <kipiakna> written as one word: the giving of a thing, the fact that or the reason why it was given
<a> and <kipialo> written as one word: that is not given, said of a permit not granted and of a tax or debt not paid
<a> and <kipiasa> written as one word: that has been given
<a> and <kipilsak> written as one word: the one who thinks himself wise, those who make themselves out to be wise
<a> and <kipna> written as one word, found before <ding>: {akipna ding} is so that it stays firm, or for it to last
<a> and <kipsa> written as one word: the one that already stands firm, that is already settled
<a> and <kipsak> written as one word: he confirmed or settled it, or the one or the thing that makes firm
<a> and <kipua> written as one word: that is carried or loaded, what a vehicle or ship is carrying
<a> and <kipuak> written as one word: it is sent or taken somewhere, the one that is sent

terms: to be sent/to be delivered/bound for
definition: <a> and <kipuakding> written as one word: that is to be sent or taken to a place
<a> and <kipuakkik> written as one word: he is or they are sent back to their country, the ones who are sent back
<a> and <kipuakna> written as one word: the place to which someone was taken, as {zato akipuakna}, the hospital he was taken to; also the sending or shipping of something

terms: be taken at once/be sent immediately
definition: <akipuak>, be taken, with <pah>, at once, written as one word: was taken there straight away, mostly of a person taken to hospital

terms: be about to be sent/be meant to be carried
definition: <a>, <kipuak> be carried or sent and <sawm> intend, written as one word: that was going to be sent, carried or smuggled to a place
<akipuak>, the ones that are taken, and <zong>, also, written as one word: those taken to hospital as well
<a> and <kipuk> written as one word: fell down or collapsed, and the thing that fell
<a> and <kipulak>, be made known, written as one word before a noun: that was announced
<a> and <kipumpiak> written as one word: who surrendered, the one who gives himself up to the other side in war
Be about to do something, from <kisa>, get ready, with the prefix <a> written joined; {thu dong dinga akisa mite} are those who were about to question him.

<a> with <kisa> written as one word, after the quality it applies to: one who thinks himself to be so, as {thahat akisa}, or a thing that is felt to be so, as {lamdang akisa}, found strange; not be about to
<a> and <kisai> written as one word: that which concerns, what is related; {tawh akisai} is concerning, connected with
<akisai> with <kha> written as one word: those who are concerned in or touched by a matter; {akisaikha kumpi thunei te} is the authorities concerned
<akisai>, concerning, and <lo>, not, written as one word: that has nothing to do with; the thing it is unrelated to stands before it with <tawh>
<aki> and <saipih> written as one word: the one who deals with a matter or whom it concerns; {akisaipih zum} is the office concerned
the prefix <a> written together with <kisak>, a form of <kisa> get ready; {pai dinga akisak lai takin}, just as he was getting ready to go

the prefix <a> written together with a form of <kisa>, think of oneself: suppose or feel that something is so for oneself, after the thing supposed, as in {maipha ngah akisak}, feel that one is favoured; not getting ready to act
<a> and <kisam> written as one word: that is needed, what is necessary; <akisam bangin> is as needed
<akisam>, what is needed, with <bangbang.2>, just as: according to need, in whatever way is required; mostly with <in> before a verb, {akisam bangbang in}, and also before a noun, whatever is needed
<akisam>, what is needed, and <bangbangin>, exactly as: in whatever way is needed, as the case requires; it stands before a verb of helping, arranging or acting, a stock phrase in promises of support

<akisam>, what is needed, and <bangin>, according to: as the need is, as the case requires; it stands before the verb, often in official statements, as in {akisam bangin thu kibawlding hi}, action will be taken as necessary
<akisam> and <bang> written as one word, followed by <in>: according to what is needed
<a> and <kisamh>, need, written as one word: what is needed, the things that are necessary
<a> and <kisamlai> written as one word: that is still needed; of time, that still remains
<a> and <kisamlo> written as one word: that is not needed, what is unnecessary
<a>, <kisam> and the plural <te> written as one word: the people who need something, as in {panpihna akisamte}, those who need help, or the things that are needed
<a> <kisam> and <teng>, here all, written as one word: all the things that are needed
<a> and <kisap> written as one word: what is needed; {akisap leh} is if needed, {akisap bang in} as is needed, and before a noun it means the needed one
<a>, <kisap> and <leh> written as one word: if it is needed, when necessary
<a> and <kisapna> written as one word: the need for something, what is needed; {akisapna zui in} is according to need
<a> and <kisat> written as one word: he or it is beaten, struck or cut with a blade, the one who is struck
<a> and <kisat> written as one word, of a village: {khua akisat} is the village was founded
<a> and <kisatgawp> written as one word: he or it is struck or hacked hard, the one so beaten
<a> and <kisatna> written as one word: the beating or striking of someone or something, or the place where it was struck

terms: come into contact with/have been in contact
definition: <a> and <kisawh> written as one word, after <tawh>, with, and mostly before <kha>: the one who has come into contact with someone

terms: be involved in/be connected with/come into contact with
definition: <a> and <kisawhkha> written as one word, after <tawh>: the one who is involved in a matter, or who has come into contact with a thing
<a> and <kisawl> written as one word: he or they were told or ordered to do something, or the one who is sent; {akisawl nana mun} is wherever one is sent
<a> and <kisehsa> written as one word: that which has been set or assigned beforehand, as an amount, a number of people or a procedure
<a> and <kisel> written as one word, <kisel> here in the sense of be hidden and not of argue: that is hidden or concealed
<a> and <kiselsim>, be concealed, written as one word: that is hidden or kept out of sight
<a> and <kisem> written as one word: it is done, that which is done or made
<a> and <kisep> written as one word: work is being done or is carried out; {akisep laitak} is being done right now
<a> and <kisia> written as one word: that which is ruined or spoiled, or it is ruined
<a> and <kisiacip> written as one word: the one that is wrecked, it is completely ruined
<aki> and <sial>, lay down, written as one word: who is laid or is lying on a bed, a table or a stretcher or in a cradle or tomb
<a> and <kisial>, boast, written as one word: who boasts; {akisial mahmah} is those who brag a great deal
<a> and <kisiat> written as one word: it breaks down, is damaged or spoiled, the one that is damaged; of a couple, fall out
<akisia> and <theilo> written as one word: that cannot be ruined or destroyed, often paired with <akimutheilo>, invisible
<a> and <kisihbawl> written as one word: he or she killed himself or herself, the one or those who take their own life
<a> and <kisik> written as one word: he repents, or before a noun the one who repents; {akisik kik} is turn back in repentance
<a> and <kisil> written as one word: he or she bathes; {akisil laitak} is while bathing
Be counted, from <kisim> with the prefix <a> written as one word; {misimna-a akisim} are those who are counted in the census.
<a> and <kisin> written as one word: he practises or trains, or what is learned; {akisin laitak} is while practising
<a> and <kisit>, be examined, written as one word: is examined, checked or tested; {thu akisit} is the case is heard in court
<a>, <kisit> and the noun suffix <na> written as one word: the examining of a case, the trial; {thu akisitna} is the hearing of the case
<a> and <kisitna> written as one word: that with which something is covered, as the cover of a drain
<a> and <kisuah> written as one word: it is made into something or split into parts, or that which is so made
<a>, <ki> and <suamlum> written as one word: who was attacked and killed, said before the name of the victim
<a> and <kisuan> written as one word: is laid on, of a duty, or is set down, of a step taken
<a> and <kisuang>, be set on, written as one word: is put up, hung or written on a wall or other place for people to see, of a picture, a notice or a name

<a> joined to a passive verb meaning be pierced with a needle, not <kisun> in its sense like: the one who has been given an injection, in the articles a vaccine; {akisun nuamlo} is one who does not want the injection
<a> and <kisun>, like, written as one word: looking like someone, as a statue made in the likeness of a person
<a> and <kisuplawh> written as one word: someone or something is lost, a loss is suffered
<a> and <kisut> written as one word: have goods taken by force
<a> and <kisut> written as one word: try to get oneself loose from what binds
<a> and <kitaih>, collide, written as one word: of vehicles, collide or be run into
<a> and <kitaih> written as one word after <damiah>, robber: be held up and robbed
<a> and <kitaihkha> written as one word: they collided, it was hit, or the one that was hit
<a> and <kitam> written as one word: it broke or burst, or the one that broke; said of a bomb or shell that explodes, a tyre that bursts and a screen that cracks
<a> and <kitan> written as one word: that is cut off or broken through, said of a limb, a finger, a cord or another long thing
<a> with <ki>, <tan>, cut, and <khia> written as one word: that was cut off, the severed part, said of a limb or a cord; not the same as <kitankhia>, be redeemed
<a> and <kitansak> written as one word: was cut off, the one whose limb was cut off
<a> and <kitap> written as one word, said of a bomb: the bomb went off or was set off; a use apart from be named after
<a> and <kitap.2> written as one word: of a name, taken from someone; {Pasian akitap} is named after God
<a> and <kitapna> written as one word: the bursting, snapping or exploding of a thing such as a pipe, a tyre, a tank or a bomb, and with <mun> the place where it burst
<a> and <kitat>, be cut off, written as one word: of a rope or thread, that it snaps
<a> and <kitawhna> written as one word: the place where the ground is dug, as a tunnel for a railway or a pit where gems are dug
<a> and <kitawi> written as one word: that is held or carried, the one being held
<a> and <kitawng> written as one word: they quarrelled or fought, and those who did so
<a> and <kitawnggawp> written as one word: the ones who fought violently, or they brawled
<a> and <kiteel> written as one word: he or it is chosen or elected, and before a noun the one that is chosen
<a> and <kiteelkhia> written as one word: it was chosen, or before a noun the one that was chosen or selected
<a> and <kiteen>, the short form of <kiteeng>, written as one word: they marry or married; {akiteen laitak} is at the time they married

terms: be going to marry/be about to marry
definition: <akiteeng> and <ding> written as one word: that they will marry, their coming marriage
<a> and <kiteeng> written as one word: they married, the ones who are married
<a> and <kiteengsak> written as one word: he or they let someone marry, gave a daughter in marriage
<a> and <kiteenna> written as one word: his, her or their marriage
<a>, <kiteen>, marry, and <zawh>, having finished, written as one word: after they married, counted from the time of the marriage
<a> and <kiteh>, be measured, written as one word: that which is measured, or when it is measured; {akiteh theilo} is beyond measure or comparison
<a> and <kitel> written as one word: that is clear, that is understood or settled
<a> and <kiten> written as one word: they marry, who married; {akiten zawh} is after they married
<a> and <kithahna> written as one word: the killing of someone, his being killed
<a> and <kithat> written as one word: who was killed; with {amah leh amah} it means who killed himself
<a> and <kithatlum> written as one word: who was killed, placed before the person; {amah leh amah akithatlum} is one who killed himself

terms: the man who was killed/the murdered man
definition: <a> and <kithatpa> written as one word: the man who was killed

terms: was preparing/was getting ready/was about to
definition: <a> and <kithawi> written as one word: he was getting ready; after a verb with {ding in} it means was preparing to or was about to

terms: set out/come forward/get ready and go
definition: <akithawi>, got ready, with <khia>, out: make oneself ready and go out to do something

terms: the man who was getting ready
definition: <akithawi> and <pa>, man, written as one word: the man who was preparing to do something, or who had got himself up in certain clothes
<a> and <kithawisa> written as one word: who or which has been made ready and is about to act
<a> and <kithawithawi> written as one word: he or they are getting ready to do something, and those who are preparing
<a> and <kitheh> written as one word: that is sprinkled or scattered; {akitheh thang} is scattered abroad, of a people
<a> and <kithehzak> written as one word: that has spread widely, said of a video, picture or report passed around on social media; also of wreckage scattered about
<a> and <kithei> written as one word: it is known, the one that is known, or they know each other; {akithei mahmah} is very well known
<a> and <kitheih>, be known, written as one word; {akitheih ciangin} is when it became known, when it was noticed

terms: be known further/become known in addition
definition: <aki> and <theihbeh>, know more, written as one word: what comes to be known in addition; {akitheihbeh ciangin} is when more is known
<aki> and <theihkhiat> written as one word: it is found out, it comes to light, before <ciangin> or <leh>

terms: if it is known/if found out
definition: <a>, <kitheih>, be known, and <leh>, if, written as one word: if it becomes known, if someone is found out doing it
<a> and <kitheihna> written as one word: that which is known, the information to hand; {tuciangciang akitheihna ah} is as far as is known so far
<akithei> and <khat> written as one word: one that is known, after <in> or <ci'n> one that is known as the thing named

terms: be found out/come to light/become known
definition: <a> and <kitheikhia> written as one word: it was found out, it came to light
<a> and <kitheilo> written as one word: that is not known or cannot be recognised; {amin akitheilo} is whose name is not known, and {akitheilo dingin} is so as not to be recognised
<a> and <kithuah> written as one word, of people: the one who is together with or keeps company with someone, who is marked by <tawh>
<a> and <kithuah> written as one word, of things: that is fitted, installed or attached in a place or to something
<a> and <kithuahpih> written as one word: the one who is together with him or her, a companion, a partner

terms: be laid one on another/be stacked
definition: <a> and <kithuap> written as one word: laid one upon another, in layers
<a> and <kithukim>, agree together, written as one word: that which has been agreed, or they agreed; with <pih>, agree on a matter

terms: be filled/be put in/be poured in
definition: <a> and <kithun> written as one word: that is put or poured into a container, as fuel into a tank or a bottle
<a> and <kitom> written as one word: the one who struggles or puts up a fight, who acts wildly
<a> and <kitomgawp> written as one word: he, she or they struggled wildly or made a violent scene
<a> and <kitomtom> written as one word: the one who keeps acting wildly and noisily, as a drunk person does

terms: go together/run together/be in step with
definition: <a> and <kiton> written as one word: going together with something; {akiton in} is together, at the same time
<a> and <kitot> written as one word: they quarrel, those who quarrel, and their quarrel
<a> and <kitotna> written as one word: their quarrel, the quarrel that took place
<a> with <kituah>, here the form of <kituak> used before <leh> and <ding>: that agrees with or fits something, marked by <tawh>
<a> with <kituah> in the sense of moving house or office to another place, marked by <ah>: moved to, that is moved to
<akituah>, moved to, with <khit>, after, written as one word: after having moved into a place, before a length of time
<a> and <kituahna> written as one word: the place where two or more things meet, as railway lines or countries
<a> and <kituak> written as one word: what fits or agrees; <tawh> marks what it is suited to, as {cidamna tawh akituak}, good for health
<kituakin>, fittingly, with the prefix <a> written as one word; paired with <akilawm> as {akilawm akituakin}, in a fitting and proper way
<a> and <kituaklian> written as one word: that falls at exactly the same time as something, or that fits it exactly; <tawh> marks the other thing
<a>, <kituak>, agree or fit, and the negative <lo> written as one word: that does not agree with or fit something, which is named with <tawh>; {thukhun tawh akituaklo} is against the law, illegal
<a> and <kituam> written as one word: kept apart from others, as in {akituam koih}, put in isolation

terms: be put on/be printed on/be let ride
definition: <a>, the prefix <ki> and <tuangsak>, put on or let ride, written as one word: that has something placed on it, as a banknote on which a picture is printed; also of people who are let ride a vehicle
<a> with the passive <ki> and <tuat>, calculate, written as one word, mostly as {akituat ciangin}: when it is worked out, when its value is reckoned
<a> and <kituh> written as one word: they compete for something or struggle with one another to get it; of seed, the one that is sown
<a> and <kitum> written as one word: they hit one another, they fight
<a> and <kitum> written as one word, of music: it is played on instruments
<a> and <kitun>, be wrapped, written as one word: that is wrapped, or the one wrapped in something
<a> and <kitung> written as one word: it is reached, things have come as far as the point named
<a> and <kitunna> written as one word: that in which someone is wrapped; {akitunna puanza} is the blanket he is wrapped in
<a>, the verb prefix <ki> and <tunna>, arrival, written as one word: the fact of having come to a state or point, as in {hiciang dinmun akitunna}, having reached this situation
<a> and <kiu>, corner, written as one word: the corner or edge of a thing or place; {akiu khat} is a corner somewhere
<a> and <kiva> written as one word: he is skilled in it, the one who is good at it
<a>, the passive <ki> and <vaihawm> written as one word: that is organised, arranged or run by someone
<a> and <kivak> written as one word: who makes a living, the work marked by <tawh> or <in>
<a> and <kivawh> written as one word: that is named, when a name is given
<a> and <kivel> written as one word, mostly before <ciangin>: when it was examined
<a> and <kivui> written as one word: he is buried, the one who is being buried
<a> and <kivuina> written as one word: the place where he or she is buried, the grave
<a> and the passive prefix <ki> with <vulhnelh>, cover over, written as one word: that was buried under earth or rubble, as in <vulhnelhkha> and <vulhnelhcip>
<a> and <kiza> written as one word: what is heard or reported, the news that has come in
<a> and <kizaih> written as one word: that was photographed or filmed, or while a photo or video is being taken

terms: be recorded/be filmed/be caught on camera
definition: {a kizaihkha} written as one word: that was recorded, said of a video or photo that happened to be taken of an event
<a> and <kizaihna> written as one word: the taking of a photo or video; after <Photo> or <Video> and before a noun it says that this is the place, thing or person the picture was taken of or at

terms: what was filmed/the one that was recorded
definition: <akizaih>, that was filmed, and the topic marker <pen> written as one word: the video or picture that was taken, as the topic of the sentence

terms: try to photograph oneself/try to take
definition: <a>, <kizaih> and <sawm> intend or try, written as one word; with <Selfie>: the one who was trying to take a selfie
<a> and <kizak> written as one word, mostly before <ciangin>: when it was heard or reported
<aki> and <zakbehna>, further news, written as one word and followed by <ah>: {athu akizakbehna ah} is according to what was further reported
<a>, <kizak> and <na> written as one word: what has been heard; <akizakna ah> is according to what is reported
<akizakna>, what is heard, and <ah>, in: a news formula that opens a report; the source stands before it with <panin>, from, and {athu akizakna ah} is as the story goes
<a> and <kizaksak> written as one word, mostly before <phetin>, <ciangin> or <khitciangin>: when someone was informed, when it was reported
<a> and <kizang>, be used, written as one word: it is used, or before a noun the one that is used
<a>, <kizang> and <ding> written as one word: that is to be used, that will be in use
<a> and <kizang> written as one word, with <zangh> for <zang>: that is used, the one in use

terms: have been in use/that has been used
definition: <a> and <kizangkhin>, be already in use, written as one word: that has already been used, after a length of time for how long
<a> and <kizanglai> written as one word, placed before a noun: that is still being used
<akizang> and <ngei> written as one word: that has been used before, that was once in use
<akizang>, that is used, and the topic marker <pen> written as one word: as for what is used
<akizang>, that is used, and <pen>, most, written as one word: the most used
<a>, <kizang>, be used, and <thei>, can, written as one word: what can be used, or it can be used
<aki> and <zangzang> written as one word: it is in use all along, the one that is currently used
<a> and <kizasak> written as one word: who was informed, or that was reported
<a> and <kizat> written as one word: that it is used, its being used; before <theih>, <hangin> and similar words
<a> and <kizatna> written as one word: its being used, the use made of it; {akizatna mun} is the place where it is used

terms: be intended for use/be going to be used
definition: <aki> and <zatsawm> written as one word: what is planned to be used

terms: since it came into use/time in service
definition: <a>, <kizat> and <zawh> written as one word: from the time a thing began to be used; a length of time follows, as hours flown or years in service
<a> and <kizawh> written as one word: it is finished; {akizawh khit ciangin} is after it was finished
<a> and <kizawh> written as one word, of an enemy: until he is defeated
<a> and <kizawi> written as one word; {tawh akizawi tawn} before a noun is that which is connected with something

terms: be allied with/be on friendly terms with
definition: <a> and <kizawl> written as one word: the one that is bound in friendship or alliance with another, marked by <tawh>
<a> and <kizawn> written as one word: they are called on or urged to do something; one sentence uses the same spelling of a person being carried, which is not covered here
<a> and <kizel> written as one word: it has spread, that which has spread
<a> and <kizelgawp> written as one word: it has spread everywhere, of news or a video
<a> and <kizem> written as one word: that is decorated with something, or that has dressed up as something

terms: the man who dressed up/man in costume
definition: <akizem> and <pa> written as one word: the man who dressed himself up as something

terms: its decoration/what it is decorated with
definition: <a> and <kizepna> written as one word: the things with which a building or place is decorated
<a> with <kizo>, here in the sense be finished, as <kizawh>: that is completed, or is managed; {akizo ngeilo ding} is what will never be finished
<a> and <kizom> written as one word: that is connected with or belongs to something, after <tawh>
<a> and <kizom> written as one word, usually as {akizom in}: one after another without a break
<akizom> and <ding> written as one word, followed by <in> and a verb of suspecting: as one who would be connected with, as in {akizomding in aki ummawh}, suspected of being linked
<akizom>, connected, with <lian> written as one word: directly joined to, lying right beside, said of lands or buildings that touch each other
<akizom>, connected, and <pah>, directly, written as one word: joined straight on to something named with <tawh>, with nothing between
{akizom sa} written as one word, <akizom>, connected, followed by a word for already: in the state of being joined, with the connection not cut or removed
<a> and <kizomsuak> written as one word: going on without a break, as {akizomsuak in}, or after <tawh> joined directly to something
<a> and <kizomto> written as one word: it goes on from there, is carried on further, also of one thing following on another
<a> and <kizon> written as one word: he, she or it is searched for, or the place is searched; {akizon ciangin} is when a search was made
<a> and <kizong> written as one word: it is looked for or searched, the one that is sought
<aki> and <zongzong> written as one word: is being searched for, the one who is wanted
<aki> and <zonna> written as one word: the searching for a missing person or thing, the search that is made

terms: be searched for/be sought again and again
definition: <aki> and <zonzon>, keep searching, written as one word before <ciangin> or <hangin>: when or although someone was searched for
<a> and <kizop> written as one word: its being joined or connected with something, usually after <tawh>; also be continued
<a> and <kizopna> written as one word: their relationship or dealings with someone, or the place where things join
<a> and <kizoppih> written as one word: who is connected with, the one in contact with someone; also an associate
<a> and <kizuak>, be sold, written as one word: it is sold, or before a noun the one that is sold
